about: The source model of a NRRD input (spec/zarrify/nrrd.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nrrd.md#53-elements>): the header file and, for a detached header, its data file, each an object described in place; the tables of NRRD's types, encodings, fields, spaces and kinds; and the roles the header, its fields, the axes and the data play, with the constraints an input must meet to have the NRRD convention's layout (spec/zarrify/nrrd.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/nrrd.md#8-nrrd-profile>). The parser checks them in this order; the projection reads a valid IR and its facts and checks nothing.

types.about: the type field's descriptors, lower case: the Zarr data type and its bytes

unsupported_types.about: types the profile names and rejects
unsupported_types.block: its blocks are opaque, of no data type

encodings.about: the encoding field's descriptors, lower case: the encoding

unsupported_encodings.about: encodings the profile names and rejects, with the reason
unsupported_encodings.ascii: its values are decimal text, which no chunk can reference as binary
unsupported_encodings.text: its values are decimal text, which no chunk can reference as binary
unsupported_encodings.txt: its values are decimal text, which no chunk can reference as binary
unsupported_encodings.hex: its bytes are hexadecimal text, which no chunk can reference as binary
unsupported_encodings.bz2: no Zarr v3 codec that both hosts read decodes bzip2
unsupported_encodings.bzip2: no Zarr v3 codec that both hosts read decodes bzip2

fields.about: the field identifiers, lower case (an alternate form names its field): the field each names

spaces.about: the space field's descriptors, lower case: the space's dimension

kinds.about: the kinds, lower case: the role of an axis of the kind (space, time or channel)

elements.about: The store IR of a NRRD input: the header file's object, and a detached header's data file's object, each described in place. h is the header's length, through the blank line that ends it (or the file's end); D the data's start in its object; B the raw data's size, or the gzip stream's (to the object's end).

lines/<i>.extent: line i of the header, its line end included: the magic first, the blank line last when one ends the header

gaps/<offset>.about: the lines and bytes line skip and byte skip pass over, the bytes after the data, and a detached header's bytes after its blank line

given.ok: the first line is NRRD0001 to NRRD0005

constraints.message: not a NRRD header: its first line is not NRRD0001 to NRRD0005

given.within: whether the bytes read without a blank line or the file's end are fewer than max_header

constraints.message: no blank line ends the NRRD header within its first 16777216 bytes

given.detached: whether the header has a data file field
given.blank: whether a blank line ends the header

constraints.message: the header ends at the end of the file, without the blank line before the data

given.problem: what is wrong with it, or absent

constraints.message: line {number} of the header: {problem}

given.field: a field the header must have

constraints.message: the header has no {field} field{why}

given.problem: what is wrong with it, or absent

constraints.message: the {field} field "{shown}" {problem}

given.name: the type field's descriptor, lower case

constraints.message: the NRRD type {name} is not supported: {named}
unknown NRRD type "{name}"

given.name: the encoding field's descriptor, lower case

constraints.message: the NRRD encoding {name} is not supported: {named}
unknown NRRD encoding "{name}"
byte skip {byte_skip} with the gzip encoding skips decompressed bytes, which no Zarr codec does

given.several: whether it names several files (LIST, or a %d pattern)
given.relative: whether it is a relative path whose segments are none of empty and ..
given.itself: whether it names the header's own file

constraints.message: the data file field "{shown}" names several data files, which the profile does not read
the data file "{shown}" is not a path below the header's directory
the data file "{shown}" is the header's own file
the data file "{key}" does not exist

given.spatial: the axes of the role space
given.times: the axes of the role time
given.channels: the axes of the role channel

constraints.message: the image needs 2 or 3 spatial axes, and the header's kinds and space directions give {spatial}
the image has at most one time axis, and the header's kinds give {times}
the image has at most one channel axis, and the header's kinds and space directions give {channels}

given.end: whether the scan reached the object's end
given.within: whether the bytes scanned are fewer than max_skip

constraints.message: line skip {lines} passes the end of {key}
line skip {lines}: its lines are more than 16777216 bytes of {key}

given.base: where the data may start: past the header and the skipped lines

constraints.message: the data's {total_shown} bytes are more than 2^53 - 1
the {total_shown}-byte data at {start} is outside the {size}-byte file {key}
the data at {start} of {key} starts before {base}, inside the header or the skipped lines
the gzip data at {start} of the {size}-byte file {key} is shorter than a gzip member
the gzip data at {start} of {key} does not start with a gzip header
